assumptions.status: Numerical validation baseline, not calibrated vehicle-track prediction
assumptions.vehicle: Source masses and stiffness; linear damping from initial slope of source damper curves
assumptions.pitch_inertia: COM scenario estimates mc*18^2/12 and mb*2.6^2/12; source inertia axes remain unconfirmed
assumptions.rail: Illustrative simply supported Euler-Bernoulli rail with distributed Winkler foundation; rail self-weight absorbed into unloaded reference
assumptions.contact: One-rail mode is an equivalent axle contact carrying total axle force; KH and rail properties are independent scenario assumptions
assumptions.twin_rail: Two independent rails with eight contacts; wheels retain vertical translation only, no roll; KH is per wheel in this mode
assumptions.motion: Prescribed piecewise-linear speed, exact interval integration; constant final speed after last knot
